Class ClientCallbackImpl

java.lang.Object
java.rmi.server.RemoteObject
java.rmi.server.RemoteServer
java.rmi.server.UnicastRemoteObject
network.client.rmi.ClientCallbackImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Remote, ClientCallbackRemote
public class ClientCallbackImpl extends UnicastRemoteObject implements ClientCallbackRemote
RMI implementation of ClientCallbackRemote: the client-side receiver of server callbacks in the RMI transport. Each callback updates the local state and/or notifies the ClientStateListener.

"Isolated liveness channel" design: only onHeartbeat() refreshes the RmiVirtualServer's liveness sentinel. The application callbacks do not touch liveness, so a stop of application traffic (but not of heartbeats) does not produce a false-positive disconnect.

The inboundNotifier is injected into the constructor as a Runnable. Until RmiVirtualServer.start() completes it is a no-op, so the rare callbacks arriving between tryRegisterName and start cause no NPE.
